arts.ttl: Watford vs Preston - prediction, team news, lineups
arts.sum: Sports Mole previews Tuesday's Championship clash between Watford and Preston North End, including predictions, team news and possible lineups.

Watford looked destined to become Derby's sixth straight defeated side on Saturday, but the Hornets struck back in style, scoring three times in the final 30 minutes to seal a 3-2 away win. Javi Graci...
